title: Use proper executor for failing requests when connection closes

timeline.message:
Use proper executor for failing requests when connection closes

Now use the executor declared by the handler rather than generic, since using
generic is trappy wrt. deadlocks.

Closes #109225
timeline.author: Henning Andersen

timeline.body:

timeline.body: This is now ready for reviews.
I think I'd rather we used a `ForkingResponseHandlerRunnable` on both branches here, even though ofc `GENERIC` doesn't reject anything today so it doesn't really matter.

reply.body: It is slightly annoying in that it asserts that the handler is not using direct executor, hence i did this route. I can make it work ofc, let me give it a shot.

timeline.body: I think we want a connection which asserts `sendRequest` isn't called? No need for it to be a method on `TestNode` tho.

Also, the `sendRequest` looks up the discovery node, hence I left it on the `TestNode` to be able to use the `transportService.localNode()`, just like `getThrowingConnection`. I could do it outside, but I am not sure I see a good reason why?
Ok I missed that, sorry for the noise.
